goal: Let external mining clients and node operators monitor memory used by active block templates
Prevents unmonitored memory pressure when templates hold transactions evicted from the mempool
agreement: Concept support for letting external mining clients track template memory usage (ryanofsky)
Tested on mainnet using a Stratum v2 template provider for 20 hours (xyzconstant)
Unaddressed objection: shutdown ordering race during template destructor cleanup (ryanofsky)
Open question on whether the interface return value should be a primitive (ismaelsadeeq)

categories.name: mining
why: P2 because it lets Stratum v2 template providers observe memory held by external templates
Prevents hidden memory leaks when templates pin transactions evicted from the mempool
